title: MLA
desc: A simple man falls for a rich landlord's daughter and in order to prove his love and marry her, he must become an MLA and succeed.

title: Dakota Express
desc: Owners of a bus, Krishna and Sundar, face numerous problems due to poor conditions. However, their life takes a turn when the daughter of the minister takes refuge in their bus.

title: Nunakuzhi
desc: A wealthy entrepreneur's flawless facade crumbles when his company faces a high-profile IT raid, revealing a complex network of tax evasion and illicit dealings that threaten to destroy his empire.

title: Kalki
desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a group of people set out to save a woman pregnant with Lord Vishnu's 10th and final avatar, Kalki, from an evil supreme god-king, Yaskin.

title: Drishya 2
desc: Haunted by the guilt over the murder, Rajendra and his family are thrown into chaos when new clues surface, forcing them into a desperate race to evade the police.

title: Rowdy Boys
desc: Kavya, a medical student, and Akshay, an engineering student, begin to fall for each other. However, an ugly gang war between their respective colleges impacts their love story.
